heading: INT. CARGO SHIP SICK BAY - NIGHT

units.text: INT. CARGO SHIP SICK BAY - NIGHT
A steel cabin the size of a closet.
A table bolted to the floor.
Storm light flickers.
The hull groans.
DR. REUBEN ABARA, 40s, a ship's physician in a bloody apron, presses a pad to the wound in an unconscious sailor's side.
The ship pitches.
Instruments skid across the tray.
He pins them with an elbow, clamps a vessel with his free hand, and wipes his brow on his shoulder.
An intercom speaker crackles on the wall.
Sick bay, bridge. Doc, how is he?
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Reuben leans toward the speaker without lifting his hands.
Bleeding. Lung's punctured. I need him on a ventilator and you've given me a bicycle pump.
units.name: REUBEN

units.text: Nearest port is eleven hours.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: He doesn't have eleven hours, Felix.
units.name: REUBEN

units.text: I know. I'm the second mate. I'm the one who found him.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Static.
Reuben reaches for a long needle and a loop of tubing.
A wave slams the hull.
The lamp swings.
Reuben shields the wound with his body, then straightens, blood on his forearm, and steadies the table with his knee.
Felix. Can you hold her steady?
units.name: REUBEN

units.text: She's a cargo ship in a gale. She'll do what she wants.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Then pray.
units.name: REUBEN

units.text: Doc, I haven't prayed since '09.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Start.
units.name: REUBEN

units.text: He slides the needle between the ribs.
A wet hiss of air.
Colour floods the sailor's face.
He breathes, deep and even.
Doc? Doc, I heard that. Is he...
units.name: FELIX

units.text: He's breathing.
units.name: REUBEN

units.text: A long silence on the line.
Then, thin and cracked, a laugh.
Good. Good. I'll tell the captain.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Reuben slumps against the bulkhead.
Slides down it until he sits on the deck, hands loose between his knees, blood drying on his cuffs.
Eleven hours.
units.name: REUBEN

units.text: Doc?
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Nothing. Keep her steady, Felix.
units.name: REUBEN
